candidate_relations.reason: The patient does have dilated cardiomyopathy with severely reduced EF (<25%) attributable to polysubstance abuse, and the heart failure exacerbation component is partially represented. However, the benchmark requires recognition of the WPW pattern (delta wave, short PR in QRS complex B, alternating QRS morphologies on ECG) as the co-equal diagnostic component. C001 entirely omits the WPW pattern, which is the distinguishing and clinically critical finding in this case.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures the underlying cardiomyopathy/heart failure component but omits the WPW pattern, which is the key ECG finding and the other required composite component of the benchmark diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Composite benchmark diagnosis requires both WPW pattern and heart failure exacerbation; ECG findings (delta wave, alternating PR intervals/axes, repolarization abnormalities in one QRS morphology) are the pivotal discriminating features not captured by C001
